entries.requirement_text: Every material_index entry shall have an intentional product output role declared in its role field. The valid roles are: runtime-framework (root-level files required for every initialized repository), governing-specification (repo-level spec contracts), validation-utility (scripts that validate or verify repository state), documentation-support (scripts that generate or maintain documentation), generated-reference (derived Markdown projections of governing specs), and initializer-framework (initializer implementation modules). No material_index entry may have role development-only; such entries shall not be installed.
